blocks.text: BUTUAN CITY — Local and national leaders are mobilizing government agencies, academic institutions, and the private sector to transform Butuan City and the broader Caraga region into a hub for homegrown startups and technology-driven enterprises. Speaking at the opening of the 10th Technology Business Incubators (TBI) Summit at the Watergate Hotel here on Friday, Nov. 13, Butuan City Mayor Lawrence Fortun and Department of Science and Technology (DOST) Caraga Regional Director Engr. Noel Ajoc underscored the need to turn local ideas into scalable businesses and sustainable jobs. READ: Agri dep’t eyes P 45-B El Niño subsidy budget The event, hosted by […]...
